questionText:
Match the specific sports program in List I with its primary objective in List II:

List I:
(A) Sports Day
(B) Health Run
(C) Run for Fun
(D) Run for Specific Cause

List II:
(I) Annual school festival showcasing track and field events and recreational mass drills
(II) Community running event promoting cardiovascular fitness and healthy lifestyle awareness
(III) Non-competitive mass run organized purely for enjoyment, recreation, and fun
(IV) Charity or awareness run raising funds for issues like cancer relief or girl child education

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

Sports Day showcases school athletic drills; Health Run promotes fitness; Run for Fun is recreational; Run for Specific Cause raises charity/awareness.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
